personality_one_liner: A modern, trustworthy, and premium employment platform built on clean iOS-native principles, featuring a strong indigo identity and crisp whitespace for serious professionals.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards are never flush to the screen edge; always use 'lg' or 'xl' margin. Ensure sticky primary CTAs have safe-area clearance at the bottom with proper scroll padding.

do's: Use for sticky 'Apply Now' or 'Move to Next Stage' bottom action bars over scrolling content.
Use for sticky filter rows or segmented controls when candidate lists scroll behind.
dont's: Never blur job cards, form inputs, or resume text regions.
Avoid stacking more than 2 glass surfaces on one screen.

screens.name: Candidate Home / Feed
screens.purpose: A personalized job feed highlighting AI match percentages, recommended roles, and quick status of recent applications.

states.loading: Skeleton cards mimicking the layout of job listing cards.
states.empty: Illustration of an empty inbox/search with 'No jobs matched your criteria today. Try adjusting your preferences.' and a CTA to 'Update Profile'.
states.error: Readable error message 'Unable to load your matches' with a Retry button.

screens.layout: A hero section at the top featuring an abstract indigo gradient card showing profile completion/resume score. Below, a vertically scrolling list of Job Cards. Job cards use 'surfaceSecondary' with 'md' radius. Each card must prominently display the job title, company name, location, and a distinct visual cue for 'AI Match %' (e.g., a 'brandTertiary' chip). Keep tap targets large.

screens.name: Job Details
screens.purpose: Provides comprehensive job information, AI fit reasoning, and a sticky 'Apply Now' CTA.

states.empty: N/A - Data should be present if navigated here.
states.error: Error loading job details with a Retry button.

screens.layout: Scrollable view with job title, company, salary range, and tags at the top. Followed by a specific 'AI Fit Analysis' section explaining match reasons and gaps using progressive disclosure (expandable). The bottom of the screen MUST have a sticky 'Apply Now' CTA inside a glass container, allowing content to scroll behind it.

screens.name: Application Tracker
screens.purpose: A timeline-based view showing the status of applied jobs (Applied -> Screening -> Interview -> Selected/Rejected).

states.empty: Illustration indicating 'No applications yet. Start applying to see your progress!' with a CTA 'Find Jobs'.
states.error: Error loading applications with a Retry button.

screens.layout: A vertical Kanban-style timeline. Use 'brandPrimary' for completed steps, 'surfaceSecondary' for upcoming steps. Date-stamped activity history per application. Centralized timeline keeping historical data accessible without navigating deep.

screens.name: AI Interview Coach
screens.purpose: Provides mock interview questions and feedback to improve candidate readiness.

states.empty: Welcome screen introducing the feature with a 'Start Mock Interview' CTA.
states.error: Error connecting to AI Coach with Retry button.

screens.layout: A chat-like or card-swiping interface for questions. Top half shows a professional office backdrop (dimmed with gradient scrim) and the current question. Bottom half offers actionable feedback chips and a 'Next Question' button.

screens.name: Recruiter Dashboard
screens.purpose: A high-level overview of active jobs, new applicants, and upcoming interviews for recruiters.

states.loading: Skeleton layout for metric cards and recent activity list.
states.empty: Illustration indicating 'No active jobs. Post a job to start receiving candidates.' with a 'Post Job' CTA.
states.error: Error loading dashboard metrics with a Retry button.

screens.layout: Top section features 2-column grid cards for quick metrics (Total Applicants, Shortlisted, Interviews). Below, a list of 'Urgent Tasks' (e.g., 'Review 5 new applicants for Product Manager'). Uses a clean, card-based layout to reduce cognitive load on the go.

screens.name: Candidate Pipeline (Recruiter View)
screens.purpose: Allows recruiters to review and move candidates through different hiring stages.

states.empty: Illustration indicating 'No candidates in this stage yet.'
states.error: Error loading candidates with a Retry button.

screens.layout: Horizontal segmented control (Applied | Screening | Interview | Hired) at the top, pinned (sticky glass). Below is a list of candidate cards showing name, AI match score, and current status. Swiping a card or tapping primary action buttons ('Thumbs Up/Down' or 'Move Stage') updates their status immediately with a confirmation toast.

hero_gradient_light.alt: Abstract light blue to dark indigo gradient

hero_gradient_dark.alt: Dark indigo and deep purple abstract illustration

interview_coach_bg.alt: Professional modern office setting for interview coach backdrop

resume_analyzer_bg.alt: Clean modern resume document on a desk

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the user's color override: Use the strong indigo (#4F46E5 / #4338CA) as the primary brand color, against a clean white background, creating a trustworthy, premium Indian employment platform.
Implement 'iOS-Native Clean' personality: Avoid web-style dashboards. Use generous spacing (lg/xl), rounded cards (md/lg), and clear visual hierarchy. Do not copy LinkedIn/Naukri layouts.
Ensure 'Job Details' and other screens with a primary action have a sticky CTA at the bottom using a glass effect so content seamlessly scrolls behind it.
For the Application Tracker and Recruiter Pipeline, use vertical timelines and segmented controls respectively to manage data without deep nesting.

All images used as backgrounds (e.g., hero cards, interview coach backdrops) MUST have a top-to-bottom vertical gradient scrim (Layer 1) to ensure WCAG AAA readability for the overlaid text (Layer 2).
Maintain visual consistency across Candidate, Recruiter, and Admin portals by relying on the identical typography (Plus Jakarta Sans/Inter) and color scale.
